AttributeIndex.luau.description: Maintains a reactive index from one attribute value to the Instances carrying that value. Instances may be added directly or tracked through a CollectionService tag. Public entry points include `AttributeIndex.new`, `AttributeIndex.Add`, `AttributeIndex.TrackTagged`, `AttributeIndex.Remove`, `AttributeIndex.IsTracking`, `AttributeIndex.GetFirst`, `AttributeIndex.GetAll`, `AttributeIndex.Observe`.
